code:
class Calculator { private int add(int a, int b) { return a + b; } }
Method m = Calculator.class.getMethod("add", int.class, int.class);
choices: getMethod returns an array, not a single method
getMethod() only finds public methods — 'add' is private; use getDeclaredMethod()
int.class is not a valid type token for int parameters
Calculator must be public to use reflection
explanation: getMethod() searches public methods only (including inherited). getDeclaredMethod() searches all methods in the class (public, protected, package, private). Fix: Calculator.class.getDeclaredMethod("add", int.class, int.class)
